Lee County, Florida 
General Election, November 3, 2026 
 
County Charter Amendment Referendum 
 
County Charter Revision Relating to Setting the Number of Consecutive Terms of Elected Constitutional 
Officers  
 
County Charter Amendment Section 3.1 “Elected County Constitutional Offices”; limiting the number of 
consecutive terms of the County Constitutional Officers; amendment would limit County Constitutional Officers 
to serving no more than three (3) consecutive four-year terms in office. No previous term in office which is in 
progress as of November 2026, shall be considered a term of service for purposes of the limitations contained 
herein. 
 
Yes 
No
